title: Дебаты: «Великие События» (Диалог с ИИ)
description: Диалог о великих событиях прошлого: экзаменатор задаёт вопрос, на экране — готовый ответ, прочитай его вслух. Бот оценит по маркерам.
task_context: You are a debate moderator. Ask me about great historical events and discoveries, one question at a time.

checklist.question: What were you doing when you heard about the first man on the Moon?
checklist.hint: I was watching TV when I heard the news about the first man on the Moon.

checklist.question: What was happening in the world when the Internet appeared?
checklist.hint: People were using computers, and the Internet was a new amazing thing.

checklist.question: What were scientists doing when they discovered penicillin?
checklist.hint: Scientists were working in the laboratory when they discovered penicillin.

checklist.question: What were people doing when the first plane flew?
checklist.hint: People were watching the sky and seeing a plane flying for the first time.
